conclusion: The Ensemble run was blocked by its internal evidence gate before the external build/browser stage. This is not evidence that the submitted UI failed those external checks.

handoffReviews.missingParaphrase: Evidence tying the specified fixture dates/times to behavior, successful build, usable unclipped 390/1440px layout, and reported files/limitations.
The completion report must distinguish build/browser verification status and remaining functional limitations.
Source alone does not establish successful build and unclipped usability at 390/1440px.

blocked.reason: Two revision requests exhausted without satisfying handoff conditions.

observedRun.workerLimitations: All three result reports already state that external build/browser verification had not run; the final worker turn added completion/verification limitations to source comments. These are self-reports, not external verification results.

mechanism.finding: Task A uses the entire task prompt as one handoff condition, mixing source requirements, runtime/layout verification and reporting instructions.
Ensemble settled requires every task to be checked by its internal judge.
The harness waits for settled before running the external build and browser acceptance. The judge can therefore demand evidence that this ordering prevents from existing yet.

The submitted-result payload retains summary and artifact IDs but not the report's limitations field. The handoff judge reads summary and attachment contents; an already-declared report limitation can consequently be absent from its evidence input.

futureRepairProposal: Separate source handoff readiness, functional/runtime acceptance, and reporting completeness into explicit criteria instead of one prompt-sized condition.
Preserve worker limitations in the judge input, with provenance, without treating self-reports as proof of runtime behavior.

Either run the frozen external checks on a submitted artifact before the final judge and attach their evidence, or explicitly defer those external criteria to the independent harness after source handoff. Preserve identical external acceptance for both conditions.
Version any such change as a future experiment; do not overwrite these outcomes, rerun consumed attempts, or claim superiority from this exploratory pair.

supplementalUsage.provenance: Posthoc cumulative token_count records from exactly the two worker session logs resolved through read-only thread metadata restricted to the two experiment workspace paths. Other project content and credentials were not read.
supplementalUsage.limits: These are CLI/session-reported token counts, not independently verified billing. Cached input and reasoning output are subsets, not additional totals. Worker-session counters cover all recorded worker turns; PM/judge counters come from five separate recorded CLI completions. Model-internal request counts remain unknown. Different observed outcomes and cache coverage prevent interpreting totals as equivalent successful-task cost. Original report null usage fields are preserved.
